method: Read object headers of every MonoBehaviour in Alterum_Data/*.assets and level* (276,821 objects).
Typeless MonoBehaviour base layout parsed by hand (m_GameObject/m_Enabled/m_Script/m_Name); m_Script PPtr resolved through a 9,253-entry MonoScript map to get the C# class name.
